description: Zips the compiled static frontend (dist/ or build/, <= 2 MB frugal limit, no local videos) and deploys it directly to OZmoz Cloud (https://api.ozmoz.io/apps/<keyApp>/index.html). Call this after running npm run build and obtaining user consent to deploy.

dir.description: Optional build directory relative to projectRoot (auto-detects dist/, build/, out/)

dryRun.description: If true, validates frugal bundle rules and size without uploading

keyApp.description: Optional project keyApp (automatically inferred from local .env OZ_KEY_APP)

projectRoot.description: Absolute project root path containing .env and dist/ or build/ (defaults to current working directory)

strict.description: If true, fails if any bundled image exceeds 80 KB

name: oz_deploy_app
